differences_and_open_items: Report p.5 lists 51B active; model card says about 50B. Keep both as source labels, not a workload multiplier.
Report p.4 series prose says 8/16/32 KV heads without per-model allocation; pinned Ling-1T config and remote attention use 8. Do not infer 32 from series order.

Report p.4 and config.rotary_dim=64 describe partial RoPE; remote attention reads partial_rotary_factor (absent, fallback 1), not rotary_dim. Exact positional runtime equivalence not resolved here; K tensor width remains 128.
Report describes one training MTP layer; pinned config omits num_nextn_predict_layers and remote configuration defaults it to 0. Do not add an MTP inference layer.
128K support requires documented YaRN/runtime override; no execution or quality validation was performed.
